scientific_question: Can layer-private 2:4 structured sparsity preserve the dense MLP's feature-boundary and residual-write fields while actually reducing stored learned state?

causal_basis.finding: Healthy seven-atom fitting used coefficient effective ranks 5.58 and 6.07 but recovered only 0.629 output and 0.295 input-JVP energy. Cross-layer sharing is the obstruction; the next family must retain independent ambient state per layer on both sides of GELU.
causal_basis.why_2of4: Every c_fc row and c_proj row owns independent learned coordinates in every consecutive input group of four. This moves activation hyperplanes and residual writes directly instead of rotating a fixed/shared plane, while matching hardware semi-structured sparse kernels.
causal_basis.nested_factorial: A dense-magnitude-selected support is an optimistic representability ceiling. A separately fitted deterministic fixed-random support is the deployable from-scratch discriminator. The second is not selected by the first and neither may change its mask after seeing fit or holdout outcomes.
causal_basis.not_a_sweep: Sparsity is fixed at exactly 2:4, both masks use one frozen construction, both fits use one optimizer path and seed, and no density, grouping, mask, learning-rate, optimizer, restart, or regularizer sweep is permitted.

family.support_rule: Partition the input axis of every matrix row into consecutive groups of four and retain exactly two coordinates per group. Supports are fixed throughout a fit.

variants.name: magnitude_ceiling
variants.support: For every group independently, retain the two largest-absolute-value entries of the exact dense-teacher matrix. Ties select the lower coordinate.
variants.role: optimistic capacity ceiling; cannot by itself authorize LM training

variants.name: fixed_random
variants.support: For every group independently, select one of the six unordered coordinate pairs from a counter-based deterministic seed 20260934 plus layer/matrix identity.

family.target_kernel: native 2:4 semi-structured sparse tensor-core GEMM; exact MFU must be certified before training

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-weight separately normalized clean-output and central-difference direction errors on dense-teacher and seven-trunk state banks.
fit_protocol.initial_values: For each frozen support, copy the dense teacher's selected entries. Omitted coordinates are identically zero and have no trainable storage.
fit_protocol.best_state_rule: Preserve the smallest discovery objective within each independent fit. Holdout and fixed-CE values never select states or masks.

report: per-variant discovery and holdout value-direction objectives
held-out output and analytic input-JVP recovery by layer and state bank
fixed-checkpoint validation CE for both supports

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: Finite execution and either final discovery objective at most 0.5 or at least 50-percent reduction from that variant's initial objective.

decision_rule.magnitude_fail: Reject 2:4 layer-private sparsity as insufficient even under an optimistic support; do not run a sparse LM or density sweep.
decision_rule.magnitude_pass_random_fail: The family has capacity but fixed-random support does not. Stop before LM training and derive one compact support-acquisition mechanism; do not tune random masks.
decision_rule.fixed_random_pass: Implement the exact fixed-random 2:4 family with a native sparse kernel, require at least 20-percent MFU, then launch only a 124M/0.5TPP verification.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Stop and report without a capacity conclusion or LM training.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run this exact zero-LM-update nested teacher-fit factorial after focused tests and measured preflight.
not_allowed: language-model training before the fixed-random functional and CE gates pass
sparsity, mask, optimizer, learning-rate, seed, step-count, or restart sweeps
using holdout values to change a support or select a state
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if measured total runtime is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified terminal/failure @Codex watchdog.
